program.section_heading: Construction Trades Readiness - Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Apply OSHA 29 CFR 1926 safety standards and demonstrate safe work practices in simulated construction environments.
Identify and respond to construction site hazards, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and understanding of Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and GHS pictograms.
Demonstrate basic construction skills in carpentry, masonry, and mechanical systems through hands-on lab activities.
careers: entry-level positions in the construction trades

notes: Noncredit program counted in hours: 'Total hours: 243' recorded as total_units. The course table prints 0 in a Units column and no hours per course, so course hours are left null.
BLDN 2301 is printed with a space; the closed list stores it as 'BLDN2301'. Treated as the same course, not a catalog addition.
The catalog states the certificate is awarded upon completion of all required courses, so all three courses are recorded as required.
